# Kubernetes Beyond YAML — kubernetes-study.katig.dev

> An interactive, lesson-by-lesson course on Kubernetes architecture for senior engineers.
> Control loops, scheduling, runtime, networking, storage, availability, and scalability.

## Product

- Site: https://kubernetes-study.katig.dev
- Offline-first HTML course. Progress stays in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- 27 units, 58 short lessons, 270 steps.
- Each lesson opens with a concept card, then drills it. A lesson finishes only after every item is answered correctly.
- Exercise types: choose one, select all, put in order, complete the sentence, say it out loud.
- Spaced review uses a Leitner schedule. The Review chip appears when items are due.
- 15 scored exam scenarios reveal in stages: attempt, self-grade against the scorer's items, debrief. They join the same Leitner schedule.
- Timestamped video clips are tied to source talks. The guidebook is `reference.html`.
- Keyboard: 1–9 select, Enter checks and continues, Esc leaves the lesson.

## Start here

- Lesson path: https://kubernetes-study.katig.dev/
- Exam practice: https://kubernetes-study.katig.dev/exam.html
- Video modules: https://kubernetes-study.katig.dev/modules.html
- Guidebook: https://kubernetes-study.katig.dev/reference.html
